description.value: Peaceful Restaurant has served Northern Chinese cuisine in Vancouver since 1998, led by owner-chef Charlie Huang whose hand-pulled noodles, dumplings, and beef rolls have earned recognition from Food Network, USA Today, and local food media. The menu centres on Xi'an-inspired flavours — aromatic spices, bold sauces, and house-made dim sum — drawing on the culinary crossroads of the ancient Silk Road. Situated on West 4th Avenue, a key cycling corridor connecting Kitsilano to downtown Vancouver, it is a convenient mid-ride dining stop.
